provider_pool: five configured org keys; shared lease, one in-flight request per key
storage: original home shards and all original checkpoints stay in place
routing: quota/model availability only; never labels, returns or predicted direction
stop: study complete or all eligible providers unavailable for pending work; integrity/configuration errors reported separately
unchanged: market units, bank, targets, variants, repeats, prompts, models, schema, output-token limits, placebo donors and raw predictions
authorization: user explicitly requested removal of internal caps and continued use of all keys with provider quota
